title: The sparsity conjecture for minimally AP-irreducible sign patterns
scope: Refutes the universal sparsity assertion for minimally AP-irreducible zero-diagonal sign patterns: an explicit order5 pattern has9 nonzero entries,exceeding2*5-2=8. AP means signed support irreducible,every row and every column positive,and Aplus-transpose(Aminus) irreducible,where Aminus retains negative entries. Every single nonzero-entry deletion fails AP. This concerns arXiv2112.00442v3 Conjecture5.1,not numerical algebraic-positive realizability Conjecture5.2.
